observations: Single car headlamp assembly wrapped in clear plastic.
Glare and plastic wrapping obscure surface condition, labels, and any part numbers.
Text overlay reads "HONDA AND ACURA" and "POSTED ON JIJI", which appears to be a seller watermark, not a label on the item.
No readable model number, part number, or vehicle fitment is visible on the headlamp itself.

claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension parts for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: One photo of a single wrapped headlamp cannot prove the seller stocks engines, suspensions, or parts for every Toyota model.

risks.risk: Headlamp lens, reflector, or mounting points are cracked or broken under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Unwrapped close-up photos of the lens, rear housing, and mounting tabs.

risks.risk: Headlamp does not fit the buyer's specific Honda, Acura, or Toyota model or year.
risks.proof: Photo of any part number or fitment label, or seller stating exact vehicle compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: as wrong fitment / unsellable to buyer

risks.risk: Electrical components such as bulbs, ballast, or wiring are missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear connector and bulb sockets, or a video showing it powers on.

proof_requests: Unwrapped photos of the headlamp front, back, and mounting points.
Any visible part number or fitment label on the item.
Confirmation of the exact car make, model, and year it fits.
response.reason: The item is a headlamp but its model and fitment are unreadable, and headlamp prices vary too widely to set even a worst-case price without knowing what vehicle it suits.
